entities.summary: Roger Maurice Bourbonnais is a former ice hockey player who represented Canada in both the IIHF World Championships and the Winter Olympics. His contributions to the sport earned him induction into the International Ice Hockey Federation Hall of Fame in 1999 and the Alberta Hockey Hall of Fame in 2011.
